title: Jacques Vallée shows Jesse VALIS as his favorite book

tellings.quote: then and then jock Valle is How I Learned of valis because I was at his apartment he was like this is my favorite book

plain: Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist and one of the best-known UFO researchers, told Michels at his apartment that the novel VALIS was his favorite book. Michels tells this himself, as the way he first learned of the book, in a conversation about UFOs and prophetic dreams with the writer Eric Wargo.
